relevance_note: Single case report of a boy with SSADH deficiency: "the patient has a homozygous pathogenic variant NM_170740: c.1265G>A (Gly422Asp) in the ALDH5A1".
method_note: Read by hand; a short script only assembled the JSON. One in-scope person (single unnamed patient, label 'patient'); parents are mentioned (non-consanguineous, reported lack of reaction to sound) but not tested or affected, so no rows. Contradiction: MRI age is given as 'At eight months' context in the case report, '15 months' in the Figure 1 legend and '20 months' in the Discussion; MRI feature onset left null. MRI sequence not named; the checklist T2 globus pallidus item was marked observed from 'high signal intensity in bilateral globi pallidi', which the authors relate to the characteristic SSADH MRI finding. Neuropsychiatric exclusions (lack of attention, aggressive behavior, disabling OCD) come from 'Similar manifestations have not been encountered yet in the boy we present', which refers back to the previous clause; under the narrow/broad rule, 'aggression or disruptive behavior' and 'obsessive-compulsive traits' are left not reported (agitation episode noted). Functional evidence is from prior reports cited by the authors, not an assay in this paper. Normal basic biochemical panel, karyotype, MLPA, plasma amino acids, VLCFA, initial urinary organic acids and congenital-infection serology are whole investigations and were not turned into specific features; the repeated urinary GHB result was recorded as excluded elevated GHB. Newborn AOAE screening showing 'possible hearing impairment' (hedged) was not recorded as a separate feature. VUS in CHD7, TECTA, MYH14, DIAPH1 were not given rows: no variant descriptions printed. CSS score 17 at 5 years not recorded (no field). Protein change printed without 'p.' ('Gly422Asp') and recorded as printed; transcript printed without version.
